newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close weak after NZ$ dives, rates.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close weak after NZ$ dives, rates.

text.p: New Zealand shares closed weaker on Friday after a big fall in the currency and a rise in short term interest rates that hit yield-sensitive stocks.
Telecom was the the engine for the key index fall, dealers said, shedding 21 cents to finish at NZ$7.45 after appearing to hold up well in the first hours of trading.

"The market was holding steady in the morning, but as the currency-interest rate battle continued it got sold off in the afternoon. Telecom accounts for almost all the fall in the index ... being seen as a yield-sensitive stock it was given the shot," Patrick Lee at brokers Lawrence Millton Howarth said.
